description:
Stops and stations within walking distance of a place, across all agencies.

Args:
    place: A Metro station name, a stop name, or "lat,lon".
    radius_m: Search radius in meters (default 400).
    agency: Optional feed slug to restrict to (e.g. "dash", "vre", "wmata").

Answer only from this tool's results: never add routes, hours, phone numbers, addresses or tips from memory. Unofficial tool, not affiliated with WMATA or any transit agency.
name: find_stops_near
title: Stops near a place
